comment: Task templates for the AI assistant window (tind-ai-ask). Static text, no model call: a template asks a few questions and turns the answers into one English prompt. Data, not code: add a template by adding an entry. group is computer or everyday (the chip row and its colour); system_data false hides the Send along choices. A field is text (the default: label, example, lines, required, note), number (min, max, default; 0 counts as empty), choice (options of {label, text}; an empty text counts as empty), checks (options, default: the ticked labels joined by commas) or check (label, default, on, off: the text used when ticked or not). heading puts a heading above a field, row lays fields with the same row side by side, show_if hides a field (and empties it) while that check field is off. A line is a string or {"text": ..., "if_attached": ["report", ...]} or {"text": ..., "if_filled": [field, ...]}; {field} is replaced by the field's answer, and a line whose field is empty is left out. attach lists what is pre-ticked (journal, report, steam); the human can untick it, and whatever is attached still goes through the Checked preview.

templates.title: Fix a problem
templates.hint: Something does not work. The Tind report and the system log are added for you; untick them if you prefer.

fields.label: What happened?
fields.example: The Wi-Fi drops every few minutes

fields.label: What did you expect?
fields.example: It should stay connected

fields.label: What have you tried?
fields.example: Restarted the computer

lines: I have a problem with my computer.

lines.text: Use the attached data where it helps.

lines: Find the most likely cause and give me the steps to fix it, one at a time. Say what each command does before I run it.

templates.title: Explain this error
templates.hint: Paste an error message and get it explained in plain words.

fields.label: The error message
fields.example: Paste it here exactly as you see it

fields.label: What were you doing?
fields.example: Installing a program from the software centre

lines.text: Use the attached data where it helps.

lines: Explain in plain words what it means and what usually causes it, then how to fix it.

templates.title: Write a script
templates.hint: Describe a job you want automated. Nothing is attached unless you tick it.

fields.label: What should the script do?
fields.example: Rename all photos in a folder by date

fields.label: Anything it must handle or avoid?
fields.example: Never overwrite or delete the originals

lines: Please write a script for my computer.
Prefer bash, or Python if bash would be awkward. Keep it short, comment the tricky parts and tell me how to run it. Do not delete or overwrite anything without asking.

templates.title: Help with a setting
templates.hint: Find or change a setting. The Tind report is added for you; untick it if you prefer.

fields.label: What do you want to change?
fields.example: Make the text bigger

fields.label: In which program or part of the desktop?
fields.example: Firefox

lines: I want to change a setting.
Give the steps in GNOME Settings or the program's own menus first. Use the terminal only if there is no other way, and say what a command does before I run it.

templates.title: Ask about my system
templates.hint: A question about this computer. The Tind report is added for you; untick it if you prefer.

fields.label: Your question
fields.example: Which graphics driver am I using, and is it a good one?

fields.label: What are you trying to do?
fields.example: Play games at a steady frame rate

lines: I have a question about my computer:
What I am trying to do: {goal}

lines.text: Answer from the attached Tind report where you can, and say so when the report does not show it.

templates.title: Fix a game
templates.hint: A game will not start, crashes or runs badly. The Tind report and the Steam and Proton logs are added for you; untick them if you prefer.

fields.label: Which game?
fields.example: Cyberpunk 2077 on Steam

fields.label: What happens?
fields.example: A black screen for a moment, then it closes

fields.label: Proton version or launch options, if you know
fields.example: Proton Experimental

lines: A game is not working on my computer.

lines.text: Use the attached data where it helps.

lines: Find the most likely cause and give me the steps to fix it, one at a time, easiest first (the game's and Steam's own settings before the terminal). Say what each command does before I run it.

templates.title: Can my PC run this?
templates.hint: Check a game or program against this computer. The Tind report is added for you; untick it if you prefer.

fields.label: Which game or program?
fields.example: Baldur's Gate 3

fields.label: How do you want to run it?
fields.example: 1440p at 60 fps, or just playable

lines: How I want to run it: {how}

lines.text: Compare it with the hardware in the attached Tind report.

lines: Start with a short yes, maybe or no, then the reason. Say whether it runs on Linux (natively or through Proton) and which settings to lower if it is close. If you are not sure of its requirements, say so instead of guessing.

templates.title: Make dinner
templates.hint: Tell it what you have and who is eating. Nothing from your computer is sent with this template.

fields.label: What do you have?
fields.example: 500 g minced beef, 2 onions, rice, a tin of tomatoes, cheese

fields.label: Use up first
fields.example: Half a broccoli, cream that runs out tomorrow

options.label: Flexitarian
options.text: mostly vegetarian, a little meat or fish is fine

fields.label: Allergies, intolerances and dislikes
fields.example: Nut allergy, no coriander
fields.note: The answer will name every allergen it uses. Always check the labels on what you buy.

fields.heading: Also
fields.label: Assume a basic pantry (salt, pepper, oil, flour, sugar)
fields.on: I have the basics: salt, pepper, oil, flour and sugar.
fields.off: Do not assume I have anything that is not listed, not even salt or oil.

fields.label: I can go to the store for more
fields.on: I can go to the store for more. Put anything I need to buy in a short shopping list at the end.
fields.off: I cannot go to the store: use only what I have.

options.label: A few items
options.text: Keep the shopping to a few items.

options.label: A full shopping trip
options.text: A full shopping trip is fine.

lines: Suggest a dinner I can make.

lines.text: Children are eating too, so keep it child-friendly: simple flavours, easy to eat.

lines: Give one recipe, or two short alternatives if what I have allows it: the dish, the total time, metric amounts for the number of people, and the steps in order. Name every allergen the recipe contains. Use only what I listed plus the basics I said I have, unless I can go to the store.

templates.title: Weekly meal plan
templates.hint: A plan for the week and one shopping list. Nothing from your computer is sent with this template.

options.label: Flexitarian
options.text: mostly vegetarian, a little meat or fish is fine

fields.label: Allergies, intolerances and dislikes
fields.example: Nut allergy, no coriander
fields.note: The answer will name every allergen it uses. Always check the labels on what you buy.

fields.label: What do you already have?
fields.example: Rice, pasta, frozen fish, potatoes

fields.label: Wishes
fields.example: Fish twice a week, taco on Friday

lines: Make me a dinner plan for {days} days.
Time I have on a weekday: {time}

lines.text: Children are eating too, so keep it child-friendly.

lines: For each day give the dish, a one-line description and the time it takes. Reuse ingredients across the week so little goes to waste. Then give one combined shopping list grouped by shop section, with metric amounts, leaving out what I already have. Name the allergens in each dish.

templates.title: Write a letter
templates.hint: A letter, an email or a short message, ready to send. Nothing from your computer is sent with this template.

fields.label: Who is it for?
fields.example: My landlord

fields.label: What should it say?
fields.example: The dishwasher has been broken for two weeks; I want it fixed by Friday

lines: Write it ready to send, as short as it can be while saying everything above. Put the finished text in a ````document block. Leave clear placeholders like [date] for anything I did not give you.

templates.title: Explain a document
templates.hint: Paste the text below, or leave it empty and attach the file after "Write the message" (+, then Files…).

fields.label: The text
fields.example: Paste the letter, contract or terms here

options.label: A summary
options.text: Summarise it in a few short points.

options.label: Plain words
options.text: Explain it in plain words, part by part.

options.label: What must I do?
options.text: Tell me what I need to do, by when, and what happens if I do not.

fields.label: Anything in particular?
fields.example: Can I cancel early, and what does it cost?

lines: Please help me with this document.
Answer from the document only. If something is unclear or missing, say so instead of guessing. Tell me when I should ask a professional, such as a lawyer or an accountant.

templates.title: Learn or quiz me
templates.hint: Learn a topic, or test yourself on it. Nothing from your computer is sent with this template.

fields.label: Topic
fields.example: How DNS works

options.label: Explain it
options.text: Explain it step by step with a simple example, then ask me one question to check that I understood.

options.label: Quiz me
options.text: Quiz me: ask one question at a time, wait for my answer, tell me whether it was right and why, then ask the next.

options.label: Both
options.text: Explain it briefly, then quiz me one question at a time and wait for each answer.

fields.label: What is it for?
fields.example: An exam next month

templates.title: Buying help
templates.hint: Help choosing something to buy. Nothing from your computer is sent with this template.

fields.label: What do you want to buy?
fields.example: A quiet vacuum cleaner for a flat

fields.label: What will you use it for?
fields.example: Daily cleaning, a cat that sheds

fields.label: Budget
fields.example: Up to 3000 kr

fields.label: Where do you shop?
fields.example: Norway

fields.label: Must-haves and deal-breakers
fields.example: Must have a HEPA filter; no app needed to use it

lines: Help me choose what to buy: {what}
What I will use it for: {use}

Give one clear pick and why it fits, then at most two alternatives for a different need or budget. Do not invent models or prices: say when you are not sure a model is still sold, and remind me to check the current price.
